source.notes: These are deterministic engineering views selected to expose terrain, material, facade, bridge and water defects. They are not historical observer or camera positions.

views.subject: terrain_shoreline
views.notes: Ground-height diagonal view across the shoreline, river mask and opposite skyline.

views.subject: grass_close
views.notes: Downward near-field view inside the authored grass-blade coverage.

views.subject: road_ground
views.notes: Walking-height view of road, kerb and nearby facade contact.

views.subject: facade_landmark
views.notes: Elevated facade view that exposes window, mullion, roof and temporal aliasing.

views.subject: bridge_structure
views.notes: Elevated long-lens-like diagonal across bridge deck, piers and approaches.

views.subject: water_reflection
views.notes: Low shoreline view that gives the river and reflected skyline most of the frame.
